# Donor vocabulary names — the ONLY place in this repo they may appear.
#
# The engine holds no robot literal: channels, sense fields and action names are
# declared at startup from an adaptor config (internal/adaptor), never compiled
# in. TestNoDonorLiteralsInEngineSources reads this file and fails if any name
# below shows up as a string literal in a non-test Go source under cmd/ or
# internal/ (testdata excluded). If a name here starts appearing in engine
# source, the robot leaked into the runtime — fix the source, not this file.
#
# Sources (read-only siblings, quoted paths are from the workspace root):
#   reachy-mini-cli/reachy/behavior/model.py     CHANNELS
#   reachy-mini-cli/reachy/behavior/rules.py     SENSE_FIELDS
#   reachy-mini-cli/reachy/behavior/library.py   LIBRARY keys
#   reachy-mini-cli/reachy/behavior/gaze.py      NAME, NAME_FACE
#   microduck-cli/microduck_cli/behavior/model.py   CHANNELS
#   microduck-cli/microduck_cli/behavior/sense.py   Sense fields
#   microduck-cli/microduck_cli/behavior/intents.py KIND constants
#
# Lines are `name` with `#` comments and blank lines ignored. Matching is
# WHOLE-LITERAL equality: a name is a leak only when a string literal's entire
# unquoted value is that name, so a donor word appearing inside an identifier
# ("active_mode") or inside an error message ("...the words to speak...") is not
# a hit. The guard looks for a robot name compiled in as an identifier, not for
# an English word.
#
# The few schema keys that ARE spelled exactly like a donor name live in
# schema_keywords.txt and are subtracted from this list. Keep this file a
# faithful transcription of the donors; record exemptions over there.

# --- channels (reachy: head/antennas/body_yaw; microduck: the other five) ---
head
antennas
body_yaw
twist

mouth
sound
skill

pat_state
